title: RAINBOW SWEET BURST  – VAPEHUB ULTRA 20000
description: RAINBOW SWEET BURST is a magical journey through a colourful candy wonderland, where every flavour sings in perfect harmony. A cascade of fruity goodness—juicy strawberries, tangy lemons, luscious apples, and vibrant blueberries—dances on your taste buds like confetti in the air. Each puff is a joyous explosion, reminiscent of childhood treats and summer festivals.
